# Session 2 transcript

DM: Before dawn, the plank walk trembles. The water under Reedholt has gone, and out on the flats a bell is ringing, three strokes and a pause.

Lena: Odalys steps out onto Moot Walk and asks everyone to be quiet.

DM: Roll Persuasion.

Lena: Fifteen.

DM: The crowd goes still. Nib Ashwater takes your sleeve and pulls you toward the tally house.

Dev: Brannoch follows. He keeps a hand on his sword.

DM: Inside, thousands of tally-sticks hang from the roof. Nib says, "The book is where the bell hangs."

Maya: Tamsin asks how long we have before the tide comes back.

DM: About two hours.

[The session continues through the fight under the boards, the climb to the bell loft, the naming of the drowned and the reading of the ledger, and ends on the groan of Crookback Sluice.]
